title: Risk Stewards: Cap Increases on Aave V4 / 2026.10.26
body: Summary LlamaRisk recommends the following parameter changes based on user behavior, on-chain liquidity, and position health observed in the latest review of Aave V4 reserves. Aave V4 Ethereum: Increase the add cap for USDC on the Core Hub Main Spoke from 50M to 75M. Increase the draw cap for USDC on the Core Hub Forex Spoke from 5M to 8M. Increase the draw cap for USDC on the Core Hub Gold Spoke from 1M to 2M. Increase the draw cap for USDC on the Core Hub Bluechip Spoke from 6M to 9M. Increase the add cap for USDG on the Core Hub Main Spoke from 90M to 110M. Increase the draw cap for USDG on the Core Hub Main Spoke from 60M to 75M. Increase the draw cap for USDG on the Core Hub Bluechip Spoke from 5M to 8M. Increase the add cap for WETH on the Core Hub Main Spoke from 60K to 90K. Increase the draw cap for WETH on the Core Hub EtherFi Spoke from 45K to 60K. Increase the add cap for weETH on the Core Hub EtherFi Spoke from 55K to 65K. Increase the add cap for LINK on the Core Hub Main Spoke from 900K to 1.8M. Aave V4 Arc: Increase the draw cap for USDC on the Core Hub USDC Maple Spoke from 46M to 75M. Increase the add cap for syrupUSDC on the Core Hub USDC Maple Spoke from 50M to 75M. USDC (Core Hub) USDC on the Core Hub holds 49.04M added and 38.22M drawn, for a hub utilization of 77.9% against an optimal usage ratio of 92.00%. Available hub liquidity stands at 10.82M USDC. Recommendation The proposed add cap of 75M on the Main Spoke lands at approximately 54.3% post-change add cap utilization, giving room for additional USDC supply to the hub. The proposed draw cap of 2M on the Gold Spoke lands at approximately 39.5% post-change draw cap utilization. The USDC draw cap on the Bluechip Spoke is fully utilized; the proposed 9M draw cap lands at approximately 66.7% post-change draw cap utilization. USDG (Core Hub) USDG on the Core Hub holds 88.57M added and 71.04M drawn, for a hub utilization of 80.2% against an optimal usage ratio of 90.00%. Available hub liquidity stands at 17.53M USDG. The USDG draw cap on the Bluechip Spoke is fully utilized; the proposed draw cap of 8M lands at approximately 62.5% post-change draw cap utilization. Most of the largest suppliers borrow stablecoins against WETH collateral, mainly USDG and to a lesser extent USDC and USDT, at health factors between 1.14 and 13.0 with a median of 1.76, so HF in the cohort tracks the ETH price. weETH Supply Distribution image 2880×1440 271 KB Source: LlamaRisk, October 26, 2026 weETH supply on the EtherFi Spoke is concentrated, with the largest position holding approximately 37% of the reserve and the top twenty approximately 96%. The largest suppliers all borrow WETH against weETH collateral at health factors between 1.00 and 1.09 with a median of 1.01, so HF in the cohort tracks the weETH/ETH exchange rate. Recommendation The proposed WETH add cap of 90K on the Main Spoke lands at approximately 51.3% post-change add cap utilization. The proposed WETH draw cap of 60K on the EtherFi Spoke lands at approximately 66.9% post-change draw cap utilization. The proposed weETH add cap of 65K on the EtherFi Spoke lands at approximately 60.0% post-change add cap utilization. LINK (Core Hub) LINK on the Core Hub holds 726,896 added on the Main Spoke against an add cap of 900K (80.8%). LINK is not borrowable on the Core Hub. LINK Supply Distribution image 2880×1440 300 KB Source: LlamaRisk, October 26, 2026 LINK supply on the Main Spoke is more dispersed, with the two largest positions holding approximately 23% of the reserve and the top twenty approximately 73%. Most of the largest suppliers borrow stablecoins against LINK collateral, mainly USDC and to a lesser extent USDG and USDT, at health factors between 1.24 and 12.3 with a median of 1.88, so HF in the cohort tracks the LINK price. Recommendation The proposed add cap of 1.8M lands at approximately 40.4% post-change add cap utilization. USDC and syrupUSDC (Arc Core Hub) USDC on the Aave V4 Arc Core Hub holds 143.45M added and 109.77M drawn, for a hub utilization of 76.5% against an optimal usage ratio of 90.00%. Available hub liquidity stands at 33.68M USDC. On the USDC Maple Spoke, 43.13M USDC is drawn against a draw cap of 46M (93.8%), and 40.23M syrupUSDC is added against an add cap of 50M (80.5%). syrupUSDC Supply Distribution image 2880×1440 234 KB Source: LlamaRisk, October 26, 2026 syrupUSDC supply on the USDC Maple Spoke is concentrated, with the largest position holding approximately 77% of the reserve. Borrowing positions hold USDC debt against syrupUSDC collateral at health factors between 1.00 and 1.49 with a median of 1.02; as collateral and debt are both dollar-denominated, HF of the positions tracks the syrupUSDC/USDC exchange rate. Recommendation The proposed USDC draw cap of 75M lands at approximately 57.5% post-change draw cap utilization, and the proposed syrupUSDC add cap of 75M at approximately 53.6% post-change add cap utilization.
